purpose: 现有 CLI 无影响查询入口；通过无断言的 Go API 客户端显示删除短路径后的距离重算及转接新来源后的范围变化。
output:
Impacts("raw-blocks") = <nil>
  daily-archive distance=1 path=raw-blocks -> daily-archive
  monthly-report distance=1 path=raw-blocks -> monthly-report
  dashboard distance=2 path=raw-blocks -> monthly-report -> dashboard
Register("monthly-report", ["daily-archive"]) = <nil>
Impacts("raw-blocks") = <nil>
  daily-archive distance=1 path=raw-blocks -> daily-archive
  monthly-report distance=2 path=raw-blocks -> daily-archive -> monthly-report
  dashboard distance=3 path=raw-blocks -> daily-archive -> monthly-report -> dashboard
Register("monthly-report", ["mempool"]) = <nil>
Impacts("raw-blocks") = <nil>
  daily-archive distance=1 path=raw-blocks -> daily-archive
Impacts("mempool") = <nil>
  monthly-report distance=1 path=mempool -> monthly-report
  dashboard distance=2 path=mempool -> monthly-report -> dashboard

purpose: 显示缺失上游及成环错误，并在每次拒绝后查询旧来源和拟接入来源，观察范围、距离与路径是否保留。
output:
Impacts("raw-blocks") = <nil>
  transfers distance=1 path=raw-blocks -> transfers
  wallet-daily distance=2 path=raw-blocks -> transfers -> wallet-daily
Impacts("mempool") = <nil>
  mempool-feed distance=1 path=mempool -> mempool-feed
Register("transfers", ["mempool" "pending-events"]) = unknown parent pending-events
Impacts("raw-blocks") = <nil>
  transfers distance=1 path=raw-blocks -> transfers
  wallet-daily distance=2 path=raw-blocks -> transfers -> wallet-daily
Impacts("mempool") = <nil>
